_comment: Starter list, curated 2026-07-02 for San Diego / remote + Emily's bioinformatics-ML and applied-AI career lanes. Every slug below was verified live via curl against the real ATS API before being added here (not guessed) — see project_job_radar memory. Add/remove freely; use `python -m job_radar.cli list --location-contains 'San Diego'` or `--location-contains Remote` after a pull to see what each company actually has open right now, since listings change.

companies.name: Fate Therapeutics
companies._note: San Diego-headquartered cell therapy/genomics biotech — all current listings are in San Diego, CA.

companies.name: insitro
companies._note: AI-driven drug discovery (ML + computational biology) — South San Francisco, worth checking for remote roles.

companies.name: Benchling
companies._note: Biotech R&D software platform — multiple offices (SF, Boston, Zurich, London), worth checking for remote roles.

companies.name: Anthropic
companies._note: Applied AI / agentic engineering lane — has 'Remote-Friendly, United States' roles alongside SF/NYC.

companies.name: 10x Genomics
companies._note: Genomics instrumentation/software — 7 of 28 current listings are US-remote.

companies.name: Natera
companies._note: Genomics/diagnostics — 59 of 188 current listings are US-remote, strong bioinformatics-adjacent fit.

companies.name: Freenome
companies._note: AI + genomics for early cancer detection — 5 of 17 current listings are remote, including a Senior Software Engineer II role.

companies.name: Acadia Pharmaceuticals
companies._note: San Diego-headquartered biotech — 28 of 53 current listings are in San Diego, including 'Associate Director, AI/ML Engineering' and 'Associate Director R&D AI Solutions & Analytics' — near-exact bioinformatics-ML + applied-AI fit.

companies.name: Erasca
companies._note: San Diego cancer biotech — 3 of 4 current listings are tagged 'San Diego, CA or remote'.

companies.name: Veracyte
companies._note: Genomics diagnostics — 19 San Diego + 17 remote of 40 current listings, including a remote/SD 'Bioinformatics Research Scientist II' role.

companies.name: Adaptive Biotechnologies
companies._note: Immunomics/genomics — 7 of 10 current listings are remote, including 'Principal Machine Learning Scientist'.

companies.name: PathAI
companies._note: AI + pathology — 5 of 9 current listings are remote, several ML engineering roles.

companies.name: LangChain
companies._note: Applied AI / agentic-engineering tooling — 7 of 102 current listings are remote (several international; check for US-remote specifically).

companies.name: Pinecone
companies._note: Vector DB / AI infra — small board (3 listings), 2 are US-remote software engineering roles.

companies.name: Sierra
companies._note: Agentic AI (customer-facing AI agents) — 3 of 145 current listings are US-remote, currently skewed sales/GTM rather than engineering.
